About Us
Our Story

The story is fairly simple. We are just a couple of ordinary people who happened to bond over our love of trading. With years of experience trading and mentoring, we came together to share knowledge and grow as traders.

Each morning, we all hop on Discord around 8:30 and trade the same way we would in a traditional brick-and-mortar prop firm. The conversation is light and mostly focused on the products we are trading. Over time, we've discussed which prop firms we like or dislike, and through those conversations, FFN was born.

As traders who have worked with many prop firms over the years, we know what is most important to you, the trader. That's why we decided to create a company based on exactly that. Without traders, capital cannot be deployed. We want you, the trader, to be our number one focus. We want you to know what you're doing, how it works, and how you can be successful.

Get Started Today
What We Stand For
Discipline

Knowing when to trade and when not to trade, knowing when to enter and when to exit, knowing when to take a walk, or even stop trading for the day. There are zero successful traders who don't practice discipline. Read that sentence a few more times. Not only do we want a network of humble traders, we also want a network of disciplined traders.

Transparency

We want to create an environment that is fully transparent, allowing all of our traders to have full faith in the process. How does the testing work? How do I get paid? Are there any erroneous stipulations before I can withdraw money? We are an open book. If you have questions that are not addressed on our website, please reach out to us. We want to answer your questions.

Humility

Trading is like running a mental marathon each day, there are ups and downs for all of us. At FFN we want to create a network of like minded individuals that practice the art of humility. As futures traders, when we are on a roll it's easy to let ego take hold. Being in a community that practices humility will help you combat that mindset. Frequently Asked Questions
How many accounts can I copy trade?

You can copy trade a maximum of 5 accounts. You cannot have more than 5 accounts trading at one time on the same product simultaneously. If that happens, none of the accounts that took that trade will be eligible for funding.

What are the preferred platforms?

At FFN, we offer the following platforms: Onyx, Quantower (FundX), EdgeProX, MotiveWave Mobile. To learn more, head over to our Preferred Platforms page.

How much does it cost to Reset my Exhibition Account?

Instead of starting over in the Evaluation account, you can reset your Exhibition account for the following fees:

$25k: $312.50
$50k: $625
$100k: $1,250
$150k: $1,875
$250k: $3,125
Can I have more than one account?

Yes. There is no limit on how many evaluations you can buy or hold. You can have up to 5 active Sim Funded accounts at one time. If you pass an evaluation while you already hold 5, the pass waits in your queue and its Sim Funded account activates when one of your 5 slots opens. Note that MAX accounts skip the exhibition stage entirely. All final decisions are at the sole discretion of FFN.

Do you offer an affiliate program?

Yes! Click HERE to join Funded Futures Network's affiliate program.

What fees do I pay once I pass the evaluation?

Professional market data fees apply to FFN Institution accounts only and do not apply to Sim Funded accounts. The Institution market data fee is TBD. It is paid from your Institution account balance.

What are the commissions on each product & what products can I trade?

For detailed information on each of the trading products we offer, see our Country Restrictions & Product List article in our Help Center, which includes the full product and commission table.

Am I (The Trader) responsible for fees?

During your evaluation period, the fees and commissions WILL be calculated and applied to your evaluation SIM balance, so it's important when tracking your PnL to account for the costs involved in each transaction.

Am I allowed to trade Micro products? Which Micros do I have access to?

Yes, you may trade E-micro products such as MES, MNQ, M2K, MYM, MCL, MBT, and MET. If there is a particular Micro product that you wish to trade, and it is not listed as one of our available products, feel free to reach out to the support team and we are likely to make the necessary adjustments for you to trade that product.

We currently list Micro ES, Micro NQ, Micro Dow, Micro Crude Oil, Micro Bitcoin, Micro Eth, and soon to come Nano-BTC (an even smaller Bitcoin contract!).

Can I trade during high impact news events?

During the Evaluation period: Yes.

While trading the Exhibition or Funded-Pro Account: For details on trading during high impact news events in both the Exhibition and Funded-Pro Accounts, please take the time to watch our video found HERE.

You must make use of Financial Juice news calendar: no other news calendar is accepted.

What is considered a T1 News Event?

T1 News Events cannot be traded. Tier 1 News includes:

For All Traders in Exhibition and Funded Accounts: FOMC Meetings (Wednesdays 2pm ET), FOMC Minutes, Employment Report (NFP), CPI

For Energy Traders: EIA

For Agricultural Traders: Agricultural Reports

You must be flat, meaning no positions or orders (including limit orders) can be open 1 minute before and 1 minute after the release. Having a resting order on your chart is not considered flat. All positions must be flattened at least one minute before the scheduled T1 News event, you must remain flat until 1 minute after the event's start time.

For example, if news is at 8:30, positions must be closed by 8:29:00 or earlier, and may only be reopened after 8:31:00.

Although news Trading Protocols are in place, you are permitted to trade around other news releases if you so choose. However, it's important to recognize that broker data issues or disruptions can happen during these events. Therefore, it is highly recommended to avoid trading during news releases to minimize potential risks. FFN does not assume responsibility for any problems that may occur if you decide to trade during these times.

Can I hold trades overnight, or through multiple trading sessions?

No. ALL positions opened by our traders MUST be closed by 04:50pm EST. Traders are permitted to trade DURING the overnight session if they wish to do so, beginning at 06:00 pm EST, all the way through to 04:50 pm EST the following day.

How does the Trailing Drawdown work?

Check out our video to understand exactly how the Trailing Maximum Drawdown works, by clicking HERE.

Why should I choose FFN?

At FFN we pride ourselves on being the most trader-focused remote prop firm in existence. FFN is a company created by REAL traders with REAL experience, and a passion for running a shop that operates with honesty, integrity, and transparency.

FFN's main goal is to bring as many funded traders on board as possible. Others in the funded trading space require overly restrictive stipulations that hinder trading, and trap traders in a frustrating cycle. FFN puts the funding of profitable traders, and the education of aspiring funded traders of the future, at the forefront of their entire operation.

FFN's founders are made up of active traders and successful business owners, who know exactly what it takes to succeed in trading, and most importantly, achieve consistency and longevity in the business of being an active trader.

You can learn a little more about us by clicking HERE.

Can I use my trading bot?

Automated trading is allowed but at the discretion of FFN. Any traders implementing HFT trading bots or attempting to exploit the simulated environment will lose access to their account.

How do Payouts work?

Be aware of the restricted times you are not allowed to trade during news events. Please refer to the rules page "trading the news" text and "Allowed Hours" video on our website.

Sim Funded Pro Account: Payouts can be requested the same day you're eligible, provided you have met your account minimum threshold and are within the consistency rule (40% for OG and Standard MAX funded accounts, 25% for Express MAX funded accounts). This account has an 80/20 profit split. When a withdrawal is initiated & processed, FFN will take 20% and distribute the remaining 80% to the trader. Maximum withdrawal of $10,000 per user per payout. This amount is cumulative across all of your accounts and you are not permitted to request several withdrawals across several accounts if they are copy traded.

FFN Institution (Live) Account: No consistency rule, and same-business-day payouts. Traders promoted to the FFN Institution start with $3,000 of real FFN capital, which can never be withdrawn. Institution accounts have a 90/10 profit split: you keep 90% of eligible live profit, and FFN's 10% generally stays in your account as additional FFN capital. Payouts must leave your Permanent Risk Buffer in place to keep the account open (see Article 4.3).

Consistency Reset: When you make a withdrawal, your consistency rule resets on that account. The consistency reset is per account after each payout. For example, if you copy trade 5 accounts and withdraw from 2 of them, only those 2 accounts have their consistency reset: the other 3 are unaffected. Note: your best day P&L never resets.

Minimum withdrawal: $500

Account Minimum Thresholds (your balance must be at least $500 above the threshold to qualify for a withdrawal):

50K Account: $52,000
100K Account: $103,600
150K Account: $155,000
250K Account: $256,000

A balance below the Account Minimum Threshold alone does not mean a broken rule, but you will have to meet the Account Minimum Threshold before withdrawing again.

Payout methods: PayPal, Rise, or Wise.

Which Countries Are Restricted?

For the full list of restricted countries and available trading products, see our Country Restrictions & Product List article.

Can I Hedge?

No. When you are in the Evaluation, Exhibition and Funded stage, hedging is considered a broken rule making you no longer eligible for funding. Hedging means holding a long and a short position at the same time in the same product, or across the ES and NQ index futures.

The same product includes its mini and micro contracts. For example, you cannot go long on NQ and short on MNQ, or long on ES and short on MES.

ES, MES, NQ and MNQ count as one family in any size. A long in one and a short in another is hedging in any combination, for example ES against NQ, MES against MNQ, ES against MNQ, or MES against NQ. No other pair of different products is covered by the hedging rule.

Can I keep all the funds I make if I decide to close out all of my accounts?

If you choose to close your accounts, you will forfeit your profits on any accounts closed. This includes funded accounts.

Article 8.1: BOGO (Buy One Get One Free Accounts)

Warren's summary

When a BOGO promotion is active, every purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns one free evaluation of the same type and size, though STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. You must activate your free account from your dashboard within 45 calendar days of purchase, and you can only have one free account active and tradeable at any time. You must hold at least one active paid account or an active tradeable Sim Funded account to activate and keep a free account; if only a free account remains active, it will be cancelled within 3 days. The free account must be the same type and size as the purchased account, and a blown free account is not reset for free.

What Is the BOGO Offer?

When a BOGO promotion is active, every purchased Standard MAX evaluation earns one free evaluation of the same type and size. Every purchased FFN Perps evaluation comes with its free account at purchase: you get two accounts, the one you buy and a free one of the same size. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. Free accounts already earned stay redeemable under the rules in Article 8.3.

How to Claim Your Free Account
Purchase a Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation during the BOGO promotion period.
FFN Perps: there is nothing to claim. Your free account opens with your purchase.
Your free account is added to your FFN dashboard automatically, in the same account type and size you purchased.
Activate it from your dashboard within 45 calendar days of your purchase (Article 8.3).
BOGO Rules and Restrictions
Every purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns ONE free account. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account.
Only ONE free account may be active and tradeable at any time. A free FFN Perps account does not count toward this limit.
To activate a new free account, the previous free account must be cancelled or resolved first.
You MUST hold at least one active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) to activate and keep a free account (Article 8.3). If only a free account remains active, it will be cancelled within 3 days.
If you FAIL the free account, cancel it from the dashboard. Then activate your next free account from your dashboard.
If you PASS the free account, it moves to its next stage like any other passed evaluation, and you can activate your next free account from your dashboard.
A blown free account is NOT reset for free.
BOGO REQUIREMENT: A QUALIFYING ACCOUNT MUST REMAIN ACTIVE A free (BOGO) account cannot exist without an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) beside it. Article 8.3: BOGO Account Rules

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Overview

A free BOGO account earned through a qualifying promotion must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase. If the free BOGO account is not redeemed within that 45-day period, the offer expires and the free account is forfeited.

Once redeemed, a free BOGO account is only valid while you also hold a qualifying account that is actively tradeable. A qualifying account is either a paid account or an active, tradeable funded account of any kind.

If your free BOGO account becomes the only qualifying account you have remaining, it may be automatically deleted under the rules below.

Activating Your Free BOGO Account

You activate your free BOGO account from your FFN dashboard.

Your free account appears in your dashboard once your qualifying purchase is complete, in the same account type and size you purchased.
Activate it within the 45-day redemption period.
You need an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) when you activate it.
During a BOGO promotion, each purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns one free BOGO account. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. Free BOGO accounts already earned stay redeemable. Only one free BOGO account can be open at a time. A free FFN Perps account arrives at purchase, so there is nothing to activate, and it does not count toward the one free account open at a time.
45-Day Redemption Period

All free BOGO accounts must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the original qualifying purchase.

The 45-day period begins on the date of the qualifying purchase.
The free BOGO account must be redeemed before the 45-day period expires.
Any BOGO offer that has not been redeemed within 45 days automatically expires and is forfeited.
Expired BOGO accounts or offers cannot be redeemed at a later date.
An expired BOGO has no cash value and cannot be transferred, exchanged, credited toward another purchase, or reinstated.
Redeeming a BOGO account does not remove any of the account requirements or dependency rules outlined below.

IMPORTANT: The 45-day redemption period is separate from the 3-day BOGO account check and the standard 29-day account inactivity rule.

The Rule

If you have only a free BOGO account and no active paid account or active, tradeable sim funded account, your free BOGO account is deleted.

This check runs every 3 days.
The free BOGO account is not eligible to stand on its own. It must be paired with a qualifying account.
An active, tradeable sim funded account of any kind counts the same as a paid account. This means you can hold a funded account plus a free BOGO account, and the free BOGO account will not be deleted. This rule is the same during a Promotion Review and while you hold an FFN Institution account.
You can identify a funded account by its account number, which begins with 2DF, EPS, EPV, or 7PV.

WARNING: At no point can you have two free BOGO accounts at the same time.

If you have an existing free BOGO account, you must remain eligible to redeem any future BOGO offer under these rules. Receiving another promotional offer does not extend, pause, or restart the original 45-day redemption period.

NOTE: The BOGO dependency check is separate from the standard 29-day account inactivity rule. The dependency check runs on its own 3-day cycle and specifically applies to free BOGO accounts that are left without an active paid or qualifying funded account.

BOGO and Promotions During a Promotion Review or in the FFN Institution

BOGO, discount codes and other promotions apply to evaluations during a Promotion Review and while you hold an FFN Institution account. Your free BOGO account is an evaluation and stays open. The BOGO rules in this article apply.

How to Keep Your BOGO Account

First, your BOGO offer must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase.

After redemption, maintain at least one qualifying paid or funded account alongside your free BOGO account.

If your paid account is cancelled, blown and not reset within the applicable 29-day period, becomes inactive, or otherwise stops qualifying, and you are left with only the free BOGO account, the BOGO account will be removed on the next 3-day check.

Redeeming the BOGO within 45 days does not guarantee that the account will remain active if you later fail to meet the account requirements outlined above.

Quick Reference
Situation	Result
BOGO offer redeemed within 45 days	BOGO may be activated, subject to all other BOGO rules
BOGO offer not redeemed within 45 days	BOGO expires and is forfeited
Free BOGO + actively traded paid account	BOGO account kept
Free BOGO + active, tradeable funded account (2DF / EPS / EPV / 7PV)	BOGO account kept
Free BOGO only, with no active paid or qualifying funded account	BOGO account deleted
Free BOGO + paid account that is blown/inactive	BOGO account deleted
Promotion Review or FFN Institution + active paid account	BOGO account kept
BOGO earned or activated during a Promotion Review or in the FFN Institution	Same BOGO rules
Two free BOGO accounts at the same time	Not permitted
Frequently Asked Questions

How do I activate my free BOGO account?
From your FFN dashboard, within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase. You need an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) when you activate it. Only one free BOGO account can be open at a time.

How long do I have to redeem my free BOGO account?
You have 45 calendar days from the date of the qualifying purchase to redeem the free BOGO account.

What happens if I do not redeem my BOGO within 45 days?
The BOGO offer expires and the free account is forfeited. It cannot be redeemed later, reinstated, transferred, exchanged for cash, or applied as a credit toward another purchase.

Does buying another account restart my 45-day BOGO redemption period?
No. The 45-day redemption period is tied to the original qualifying purchase and does not restart or extend because another account is purchased.

Is the 45-day rule the same as the 3-day BOGO check?
No. They are separate rules. The 45-day rule determines how long you have to redeem your promotional BOGO account. Once the BOGO is redeemed, the 3-day dependency check determines whether you continue to meet the requirements to keep the free account.

How often is the BOGO account check run?
Every 3 days.

Does a funded account let me keep my free BOGO account?
Yes. An active, tradeable funded account of any kind counts the same as a paid account. A qualifying funded account plus a free BOGO account keeps the BOGO account from being deleted. A Promotion Review or an FFN Institution account does not change this.

How do I know if an account is a funded account?
A qualifying funded account's number begins with 2DF, EPS, EPV, or 7PV.

Can I use BOGO and other promotions during a Promotion Review or while I hold an FFN Institution account?
Yes. BOGO, discount codes and other promotions apply to evaluations at any time, and the usual BOGO rules apply.

Why was my free account deleted?
If your only remaining account was a free BOGO account with no active paid account or active, tradeable qualifying funded account, it may have been removed during the 3-day check. If the BOGO offer was never redeemed and more than 45 days have passed since the qualifying purchase, the BOGO offer has expired and is no longer valid.

Can I keep just the free BOGO account by itself?
No. A free BOGO account must be paired with a qualifying paid account or an active, tradeable qualifying funded account.

Can I have two free BOGO accounts at once?
No. At no point can you have two free BOGO accounts at the same time.
